nodes.title: A voice stack marked 'beta' runs test calls only; the dial gate refuses it for any call to a real person until its listed risks are cleared and it is marked available.
nodes.source: main loop, on the voice builder's M3 report
nodes.rationale: The speech-to-speech stack (v2-live) played audio before the door read it (review M3). The runtime now holds each turn until every sentence passes the door, which makes it safe but slower than its 1.2 s card said, and that gap is unmeasured. Sarvam (also beta) has an unresolved data-training term. Offering a stack whose safety or speed is unverified on real calls breaks the product's honest-number rule.
nodes.reverse_if: a beta stack passes the reply-door attack battery on its real transport and its reply gap with the hold is measured from India (n>=30 turns); then it is marked available
